verdict.rationale: Orama explicitly lists 'Typo Tolerance' as a feature and a hands-on runtime probe confirms search({term:'infrastucture', tolerance:2}) correctly returns the typo-matched document, with a tunable 'tolerance' parameter controlling fuzzy matching strength. missing for 10: no docs excerpt detailing the full range of tunable rules (per-field tolerance, exact-match toggles) or independent third-party benchmarking beyond the single probe.
